text.p: The Asian unit of Danish film producer Scanbox Danmark, Scanbox Asia Pacific Ltd (SAPL) said on Monday its partial float had closed oversubscribed ahead of its listing on the Australian Stock Exchange later this month.
SAPL offered 15 million shares at 80 cents each to investors to raise A$12 million in a float fully underwritten by brokers Bell Securities.
Scanbox Danmark will hold 51 percent of SAPL, new investors 37.5 percent and the balance held by senior management and development capitalists.

In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), SAPL said it would produce films created for the international market and many of these films would be sold through its parent's established international distribution network.
Scanbox group productions have included the films Bikini Carwash I and II, Nemesis I, II, III and IV and Sabotage.
SAPL said it expected to list in the week commencing May 19.
